title: Mapping Your Own Green Career Path

body.en: Akosua wanted a career in climate work but didn't know where to start — she wasn't a scientist, an engineer, or a policy graduate. What she found, once she actually looked, was a career map far wider than she expected: data analysis for climate risk modelling, communications for NGOs, logistics for renewable energy rollouts, finance for green business loans. Climate careers aren't one narrow lane. They're an entire economy reorganising itself, and it needs people with all kinds of existing skills pointed at a new problem.

followUpQuestion: What assumption about climate careers did Akosua have to unlearn before she found her path?
